svg.title: Contoso Motors APIM entry and specialist routes
svg.desc: The certificate requester calls the APIM entry API, which invokes the Hosted Router with APIM managed identity. The same Router calls either the supplier or logistics specialist API using its Gateway API application role. APIM forwards to Studio with the shared delegated connection, or to the Foundry logistics A2A endpoint with its managed identity. APIM does not host agent prompts.

text.tspan: APIM holds API routes and policies. Agent prompts and models stay in Foundry and Copilot Studio.
The Router is the entry API's backend, then the caller of a specialist API. Full paths are in the table below.
